scope: all objects reachable from refs after checkout fetch-depth=0 plus git fetch --all --tags --prune
root_cause: The prior scanner could deadlock while writing the full object list to git cat-file stdin before draining stdout. The fix uses subprocess.communicate() for concurrent pipe IO.
truth_boundary: NO_EXACT_MATCH is proven only for objects reachable from the fetched repository refs. It does not prove absence from external archives, local-only files, expired artifacts, or unreachable/pruned Git objects.
